deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 13-15): Grothendieck is computing a presentation of the extension E of Γ = S_3 (later S_3 × Z/2, adding complex conjugation τ) by π = π_1(P^1(C) − {0,1,∞}, P).

The elements involved:
- l_0, l_1, l_∞ are loops around the punctures, related by a product relation l_0 l_1 l_∞ = 1 in some order.
- σ_0, σ_1, σ_∞ are lifts to E of the three transpositions of {0,1,∞}. Each transposition has a fixed point in U (2, −1, 1/2), so it has an order-2 lift.
- ρ is the order-3 lift of the 3-cycle, i.e. rotation about a base point P fixed by ρ.
- ε_i are 'half-twists' around the puncture i. ε_i lifts the transposition fixing i, and ε_i^2 = l_i.

In modern terms E (without τ) is the orbifold fundamental group of [M_{0,4}/S_3], the λ-line modulo S_3, i.e. the j-line. So E ≅ PSL_2(Z) = Z/2 * Z/3, with π ≅ Γ(2)/±1 free of rank 2. With τ, E ≅ PGL_2(Z).

On p.13 he derived σ_0 = ε_0 ε_1^2 etc., and from ρ^3 = 1 obtained (ε_0 ε_1 ε_∞)^2 = 1. This seemed 'inquiétant' because he believed there are no finite-order elements in the relevant group.

On this page he first tries to force ε_0 ε_1 ε_∞ = 1 (boxed). He rewrites it in terms of the l_i, σ_i and deduces 'prettier' formulas σ_0 = ε_∞^{-1} ε_1, σ_1 = ε_0^{-1} ε_∞, σ_∞ = ε_1^{-1} ε_0. From these follows the 'unexpected' relation σ_∞ σ_1 σ_0 = 1.

He then corrects himself: 'Sans doute ε_0 ε_1 ε_∞ = σ_1'. This is equivalent to ε_0 = ε_1 ε_∞ ε_1^{-1} etc., i.e. the ε's permuted by conjugation.

The whole block is struck out with diagonal lines. It is followed by 'Critique des relations et de l'approche':
- the elements l_i, σ_i, ε_i, f live in discrete groups, which must be distinguished from the profinite ones;
- for the discrete groups one should use the topology directly.
The next page restarts properly in the geometric language of fundamental groupoids of U_{0,3} with an S_3 × Z/2-equivariant structure (the rotation ρ, symmetries σ_i, conjugation τ). This is the (0,3)/(0,4) level of the Teichmüller tower with its symmetries, as in the Esquisse. The page is a scratch computation serving the Galois-action / Grothendieck–Teichmüller program.
errors: The boxed relation ε_0 ε_1 ε_∞ = 1 is false. Each ε_i maps to a transposition in S_3, so the product maps to an odd permutation, not 1. Also, the ε_i are conjugates of the parabolic generator T of PSL_2(Z); their product maps to 3 ≠ 0 in the abelianization Z/6.
Consequently σ_0 = ε_∞^{-1} ε_1 etc. are false. The right side maps to an even permutation (a 3-cycle or 1), not a transposition.
σ_∞ σ_1 σ_0 = 1 is false: the product of three transpositions is odd.
The underlying worry 'no element of finite order' is mistaken for the extension E: E ≅ PSL_2(Z) has torsion (σ_i of order 2, ρ of order 3). Only π itself is torsion-free.

The corrected guess ε_0 ε_1 ε_∞ = σ_1 (an order-2 lift) is consistent. With ε_0 = [[1,1],[0,1]], ε_1 = [[1,0],[-1,1]], ε_∞ = [[0,1],[-1,2]] (parabolics fixing the cusps ∞, 0, 1 ↦ λ = 0, 1, ∞), the product is [[-1,2],[-1,1]]. This has trace 0, hence order 2, and fixed point 1+i, which maps to λ = −1, the fixed point of σ_1: z ↦ 1/z. So it is the order-2 lift of σ_1 for an appropriate base point. In the other cyclic order the product is parabolic. Grothendieck evidently struck the whole block anyway.

ideas.what: Extension of S_3 (×Z/2) by π_1(P^1 − {0,1,∞}), with half-twist lifts ε_i of the transpositions (ε_i^2 = l_i) and order-2 lifts σ_i
ideas.modern_name: Orbifold fundamental group of M_{0,4}/S_3 ≅ PSL_2(Z) (PGL_2(Z) with complex conjugation); Γ(2) ⊂ PSL_2(Z)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (λ-function, Γ(2), modular group); in the GT context Drinfeld 1990, Ihara, Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984) discusses the (0,3),(0,4) levels of the Teichmüller tower with their symmetry groups and the relation to SL_2(Z)

ideas.what: Self-critique: distinguish discrete (topological) π_1 from the profinite π_1 when writing relations
ideas.modern_name: Discrete vs profinite fundamental group / comparison theorem

deep.surprise_reason: A crossed-out scratch computation of relations in the S_3-extension of π_1(P^1 − {0,1,∞}), i.e. PSL_2(Z). It contains false intermediate relations that Grothendieck himself abandoned. The corrected guess is a standard fact. Nothing absent from the literature.
